title: 724. Max Stack

examples.explanation: Push 5, 1, 5. Top is 5; popMax removes the upper 5; top is 1; peekMax is 5; pop removes 1; top is 5.
Push 1 then 2; popMax removes 2; top is 1.
Push 2 then 7; the max is 7; pop removes 7; the max becomes 2.

hints: Track the maximum alongside the values: a parallel max stack makes top and peekMax O(1).
popMax must remove the topmost copy of the maximum; buffering the elements above it and pushing them back works.
Construction and push report "null"; pop, top, peekMax and popMax report plain integers.
